image_description: A dark green plastic rain barrel positioned outdoors against a white wall and wooden fence. The barrel is cylindrical with horizontal reinforcing ribs. A white downspout diverter enters the top of the barrel from the left. A spigot with a green hose attached is visible near the base. The ground is covered in mulch.
